text:
Sofia: Need quick approval question  candidate accepted but requested a $9k 2visa-bridge2 stipend plus $4k sign-on. L4 sign-on cap is $8k and we don't normally pay visa bridging separately. Can we route an exception?

Rahul: Context: candidate's start is delayed 6 weeks pending work authorization. Hiring manager asks for a one-time bridge stipend to cover short-term relocation/visa expenses so candidate can commit to the start date. Total onboarding cash would be $13k.

Keisha (Recruiter): Offer signed at 07:22. Candidate agreed to start 2025-07-15 if bridging stipend paid. Otherwise they may push to late August. Manager prefers earlier start to keep sprint velocity.

Sofia: Two items: 1) approval to treat the visa-bridge as taxable stipend and allow combined onboarding >$10k; 2) confirm whether stipend can be paid as reimbursement vs upfront.

Payroll: Reimbursement preferred for visa expenses; however, if paid as stipend it becomes taxable in the pay period. Any combined onboarding >$10k routes to Comp Committee + Finance.

Rahul: Manager justification: "maintain release cadence; candidate has niche infra skills; delay impacts roadmap." Uploaded justification and signed offer to HR-975.

Keisha (Recruiter): Comp stub:
```
Base: $135,000
Level: L4
Requested sign-on: $4,000
Visa-bridge stipend: $9,000
Total onboarding cash: $13,000
Start requested: 2025-07-15
Payment preference: reimbursement for receipts or one-time stipend
Justification: critical infra coverage; start delayed by visa timeline
```

Comp Committee Chair: Acknowledged. We'll triage as an exception; prefer reimbursement + receipts to reduce precedent. Will review today and advise whether to approve one-off stipend.

Sofia: If comp committee approves reimbursement approach, candidate will accept and sign addendum. Please flag as "one-off - visa bridge" to avoid policy drift.

Payroll: Noted. If reimbursement route chosen, we need receipts uploaded within 60 days. If stipend chosen, will process with standard withholding.

Keisha (Recruiter): Candidate can provide receipts but prefers upfront to secure flight + short-term housing. Asking for expedited decision by 17:00 local.

Comp Committee Chair: Will push for same-day decision. If approved, finance will allocate to GL 220-1487 (Onboarding).

Sofia: Thanks all 1 will update HR-975 with committee decision and confirm start date with the candidate once final.
